posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared stunning photos from her Maldives and London getaways, while pregnancy rumors continue to swirl. She also wished director Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid rift rumors.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit dropped the trailer for 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' and released a new collaboration 'Kya Kamaal Hai.' He also addressed the pro-Khalistani controversy and has upcoming concert dates.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia returned to Mumbai from Cannes 2026 with Ranbir Kapoor, spotted at the airport wearing a 'TIRED' T-shirt. She faced trolling over her Cannes look and is reportedly confirmed for India's Got Latent Season 2.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka returns to Indian cinema in SS Rajamouli's mega-budget 'Varanasi' alongside Mahesh Babu, set for an April 2027 release. She also hints at another Bollywood comeback with Sanjay Leela Bhansali.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK reunites with Anil Kapoor, Rani Mukerji, and Jackie Shroff in 'King,' which faced AI-generated leaks prompting heightened security. Reports also suggest a potential 'Main Hoon Na 2' reunion with Farah Khan.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena celebrated son Taimur's Taekwondo achievement and shared heartwarming family moments. Her viral pool party photo and a candid statement about her father also made headlines.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha locked a massive paycheque for her next film with Ekta Kapoor and officially confirmed her relationship with Rahul Mody. A prequel to her blockbuster 'Stree' is also reportedly in development.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is using a body double for action sequences in Atlee's 'Raka' and SRK's 'King' due to her pregnancy. She also reunites with Prabhas in Sandeep Reddy Vanga's upcoming film 'Spirit.'

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: FWICE imposed a non-cooperation ban on Ranveer over his abrupt exit from 'Don 3,' with Excel Entertainment seeking ₹45 crore in damages. Meanwhile, 'Dhurandhar 2' is closing in on the ₹1,150 crore mark at the box office.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya dazzled at Cannes 2026 with a sapphire blue gown, blush pink couture, and a bold white pantsuit for her 24th appearance. Kangana Ranaut defended her against ageist trolls, and daughter Aaradhya joined her on the red carpet.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika turned heads presenting at the Anime Awards 2026 in Tokyo alongside Black Panther's Winston Duke, who called her 'incomparable.' Her romantic track 'Tujhko' with Shahid Kapoor from 'Cocktail 2' also dropped.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: The trailer for Samantha's 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' dropped, showing her as a ruthless daughter-in-law in a bold new role. The film, produced under her own banner Tralala Moving Pictures, releases June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's collaboration with director Basil Joseph is confirmed but won't be Shaktimaan. He also met RCB's Venkatesh Iyer after an IPL match, and his sci-fi film with Atlee continues to build buzz.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' is set for a massive June 4 release with advance bookings crossing $393K in North America. He apologized to Jasprit Bumrah after hilariously calling him a 'footballer' at a promo event.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' shoot with Prashanth Neel paused again as the team reworks his look for perfection. He confirmed a packed four-film lineup including War 2, Dragon, Devara 2, and a Nelson Dilipkumar project.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is promoting 'Peddi' alongside Ram Charan ahead of its June 4 release and celebrated New Balance Grey Days 2026 with cricketer Pat Cummins. The film's latest song 'Hellallallo' set screens on fire.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's romantic drama 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya saw a 21% jump on Day 2, crossing ₹7 crore. The film received a BOGO push on May 25 as youth audiences warmed up to its Dharma-style romance.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara and Sidharth Malhotra announced their pregnancy, receiving congratulations from the entire Bollywood fraternity. She also shared fan reactions to her hit film War 2 and reflected on her Met Gala experience.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's 'Krrish 4' remains stuck in limbo over a VFX disagreement with the production team. He and Jr NTR continued their fun promotional banter for War 2 with billboards and social media exchanges.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' trailer launched with father David Dhawan emotionally praising him. The rom-com has been postponed to June 12 to avoid clashing with Yash's 'Toxic.'

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya announced her 'All Hearts Tour' and 'Unstoppable Tour' dates across the US, including a highly anticipated Newark show on September 5. Tickets for VIP and front-row seats are selling fast.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman performed a live concert in Bhopal for 'Peddi Ki Aawaz,' unveiling the film's new track with Ram Charan. He also praised Hans Zimmer's perspective on their 'epic' Ramayana soundtrack collaboration.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay turned 51 on May 25 with birthday wishes pouring in from stars like Nayanthara and Atlee. His final film 'Jana Nayagan' is still awaiting CBFC certification, with the producer promising a release date soon.
